patch_description: Replace the exponentially-weighted moving average (which introduces significant lag, lag_error=0.38) with a zero-lag dual-pass filter: forward EMA followed by a backward EMA cancels phase delay, and a Savitzky-Golay-style local polynomial fit evaluated at the window center preserves slope dynamics and reduces spurious slope changes/false reversals. The polynomial fit preserves genuine trends (high tracking accuracy) while the EMA passes suppress broadband noise, improving smoothness and noise reduction simultaneously with minimal added computation (O(W) per sample with precomputed SG coefficients via least-squares). The combination (zero-lag EMA cascade + centered polynomial fit, blended 50/50) attacks all four objectives: slope-change minimization (smooth polynomial fit), lag minimization (backward pass cancels phase), tracking accuracy (centered fit follows local trend), false-reversal penalty (noise is heavily attenuated before derivative estimation).
